findings.detail: C107 flags source-disclosed negative amortized costs on revolving facilities even though the extracted signs and amounts match the filing.

rationale: False alarm: the March 31, 2026 schedule itself prints parenthesized negative amortized cost for the flagged revolving facilities. The extracted values -12,191, -1,250, and -6,216 exactly match cited source rows, so negative cost is legitimate here and C107 is an overbroad monitoring rule rather than evidence of a data defect.
